steps.eval: const selectors = ['#so-edit-story','#so-update-story','#so-fix-with-wizard','#so-stagecraft','[data-so="curator-proposal"]','[data-so="curator-op"]','[data-so="curator-accept"]','[data-so="curator-reject"]','[aria-label="In-play driver"]','[aria-label="Advance target"]','[aria-label="Nudge text"]','[aria-label="Driver suggestions"]','[aria-label="Driver report"]','[aria-label="Active nudge"]','[aria-label="Driver unavailable"]','[aria-label="Talk decisions"]']; const surfaces = ['#drawer-manager','#so-hud','#story-orchestrator-settings']; const present = surfaces.filter((surface) => document.querySelector(surface)); const hits = []; for (const surface of present) { const root = document.querySelector(surface); for (const selector of selectors) if (root.querySelector(selector)) hits.push(surface + ' ' + selector); } if (present.length !== surfaces.length) throw new Error('a player surface is missing from the DOM: ' + JSON.stringify(present)); if (!hits.length) throw new Error('author view rendered none of the swept controls — the selector list is stale'); return { surfaces: present, hits };
